mapper.select: SELECT * FROM video_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND resource_id = #{resourceId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM video_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY last_watched_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_progress (user_id, resource_id, last_position, watch_percent, duration_watched, play_count, last_watched_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId},#{resourceId},#{lastPosition},#{watchPercent},#{durationWatched},#{playCount},#{lastWatchedAt},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_position=VALUES(last_position), watch_percent=VALUES(watch_percent), duration_watched=VALUES(duration_watched), play_count=VALUES(play_count), last_watched_at=VALUES(last_watched_at), updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
